essentials.title: Flights
essentials.text: Out, British Airways: BA0186 Austin (AUS) Monday September 21 at 10:30 PM to Heathrow (LHR) Terminal 5, lands 1:55 PM September 22, Club World. Connect at Terminal 5, about 5 hours. BA0522 Heathrow 7:05 PM to Florence Peretola (FLR), lands 10:20 PM, Club Europe. Two checked bags at 32 kg each on both legs. Arno Travel's transfer meets you outside baggage claim with an ECCELLENZE sign and takes you to Borgo Pignano Florence. Home: United KYMT99 was cancelled September 19 and refunded in full. The return on October 16 is rebooked on points, details to follow.

essentials.title: Rental car
essentials.text: Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic, unlimited km. Pick up Florence Vespucci (FLR) Friday September 25, booked for 9:00 AM, move to 12:00. Drop Rome Fiumicino (FCO), booked for Saturday October 10 at 12:00 PM; stays as booked if the 10th is Rome, extends to the 11th if the 10th is the coast. $1,358.61 prepaid. Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for the Amalfi leg.

essentials.title: Why this trip
essentials.text: Italy collection for Suites With Keith / Fora, releasing print and digital February / March 2027. Eccellenze hosts the first two Florence nights. Everything after is site inspections, shoots and hosted or paid stays.

essentials.title: Drive times
essentials.text: Tuscany to Portofino about 3 hours. Portofino to Cernobbio about 2 hours 45. Como to the Dolomites about 3 hours. Alpe di Siusi to Montalcino about 4 hours 30, the longest day. Val d'Orcia to Rome about 2 hours 30. Rome to Positano about 3 hours.

essentials.title: Pace
essentials.text: This is a sketch, not a schedule. Slow mornings, gym and breakfast, no hotel departures before 11:00. One property visit a day is the target, two is the ceiling, and where you are staying counts as seen. Times on the page are suggestions to steer replies toward, not commitments. If a day feels full, drop the second stop.

Plaza e de Russie in Viareggio (Salvatore Madonna, also in the room) is ten minutes away.

End of their season, they close in early October, so a hosted night on the 29th is a soft ask. No contact yet, email the general inbox. Take whichever of Augustus and Principe hosts, Augustus if both.

stay.detail: Hosted night, confirmed. Nut allergy noted. You told Gaetano about 3:00; if Villa d'Este moves to 2:00 it is closer to 4:00, which is fine. days.label: Drive down, Lupaia at golden hour

stay.detail: Poggio alla Sala is off, you want somewhere else. Needs to be within reach of Lupaia for the evening of the 8th and Rosewood for lunch on the 9th. Cinzia never answered. Yours to pick, the page updates when you do.

items.title: Leave Alpe di Siusi after gym and breakfast, straight down the A1
items.detail: About 4 hours 45 to Montepulciano. No Modena stop.

items.title: Check in at the Val d'Orcia base, drop the bags
Lupaia, site inspection in the last light, then dinner
items.detail: Christopher invited you for lunch and an inspection on the 9th. Since Rosewood now has you for lunch that day, the ask is to come the evening before: inspection around 5:30, sunset is about 6:40, dinner after if they can seat a non-guest. If dinner is a no, the 5:30 visit still works and you eat at Poggio. 15 minutes from Poggio.
items.todo: Send Lupaia the change: the evening of the 8th instead of lunch on the 9th (draft ready).

items.name: Reschio as a stay
items.detail: Sold out for the 29th too, checked September 22. Florian's visit and lunch on the 10th no longer fits the routing. Next trip.

items.name: Castello di Velona
items.detail: Sold out.

items.name: Castello Banfi Il Borgo as a stay
items.detail: Maddalena Vedele, September 21: fourteen suites, exceptionally high demand.

blocks.name: Val d'Orcia, Porto Ercole & Rome
blocks.summary: Rosewood, Banfi and Monteverdi on the 9th, fully hosted. The 10th is open until the replies land: Hotel Eden for two hosted nights if the Dorchester story lands, which would make La Minerva the comped 12th only, or La Roqqa, Pellicano at 830, or an early Rome night. Then La Minerva as booked and the car back at Fiumicino on the 10th or 11th.

stay.name: Monteverdi Tuscany, Castiglioncello del Trinoro
stay.detail: Confirmed. Booking 64755, Tuscan View Suite, Agent Stay, total 0 euros, arriving the 9th, out the 10th. Lucia Testa (Reservations & Guest Experiences Manager) has booked the spa circuit at 5:00, the aperitivo at the Lounge Bar at 6:15 and the Chef's Table at Zita at 7:00, nut allergy noted. She offers a garden walk and a few rooms on the morning of the 10th before you leave. Peggy Picano-Nacci offered the stay September 22. Pre-arrival questionnaire in the confirmation email.

items.title: Leave the base, 45 minutes to Castiglion del Bosco
items.detail: The one morning you leave before 11, by your own choice, to get the spa in at Monteverdi.

items.title: Rosewood Castiglion del Bosco, site inspection, then lunch at 12:30
items.detail: Francesca confirmed the reorder September 22: inspection at 11:00, Osteria La Canonica opens at 12:30, the team knows you leave by 1:30. Self-driving.

items.title: Castello Banfi Il Borgo, site inspection and tasting
items.detail: Maddalena Vedele confirmed 2:00 on September 22, no cellar tour. About 25 minutes south of Rosewood.

items.title: Banfi to Monteverdi
items.detail: About 1 hour 15 east.

items.title: Monteverdi: spa circuit at 5:00, aperitivo at 6:15, Chef's Table at Zita at 7:00
items.detail: Arrive about 4:15 to drop bags and settle. The gallery, Caragh Thuring, whenever you have a gap.

days.label: Monteverdi morning, then Rome or Porto Ercole

stay.name: Open, decide once replies land

options.name: Hotel Eden, Rome, hosted, two nights
options.detail: Dorchester Collection, and you just placed the Sherwanis at Le Meurice and The Beverly Hills Hotel. Two drafts ready: an intro ask to Pascal Billard at Le Meurice, and the direct ask to the Eden for October 10 to 12, one night as the fallback, visit after that. If Eden hosts two nights, La Minerva becomes the comped 12th only and the 670 paid night goes, which is a word with Egle at Eccellenze once Eden answers. Three Rome nights, all hosted.

options.name: Il Pellicano, 830 euros
options.detail: Gianluca's offer for the 10th alone. Acceptance drafted, not sent. Monteverdi to Porto Ercole about 2 hours, Pellicano to Fiumicino 1 hour 45 on the 11th.

options.name: La Roqqa, if Roberta hosts
options.detail: Asked the 21st, no reply. Five minutes from Pellicano, which could then be a visit.

options.name: Rome a night early
options.detail: La Minerva third night, Egle draft on hold, or Bulgari, J.K. Place, Hassler. Monteverdi to Fiumicino about 2 hours, car back on the 10th as booked.

stay.detail: Your call once La Roqqa and Eden answer. A hosted Eden beats a paid Pellicano. The Avis drop stays on the 10th at noon until it is decided, then moves or extends.

items.title: Monteverdi garden walk and a few rooms with Lucia, then the light over the valley
items.detail: Offered for the morning of the 10th, weather permitting. Shoot the hamlet before you leave.

items.title: Spa circuit, the gallery, breakfast at Monteverdi, out by 11:00
Coast or Rome, depending on the 10th

stay.name: Orient Express La Minerva
stay.detail: Confirmed as booked, the hosted night. Egle Antanaityte: 1 night complimentary plus 1 at 670 euros, October 11 to 13. If Eden hosts October 10 to 12, ask Egle in person at Eccellenze to move the comped night to the 12th and drop the paid one. Until Eden answers this stays as it is.

options.name: Hotel Eden, night two, if they host
options.detail: Then La Minerva moves to the 12th only.

items.title: Arrive La Minerva from the coast or already in Rome
items.detail: If the 10th is the coast, the car drops at Fiumicino on the 11th and Avis extends a day. If Rome, you are already there.

items.title: La Posta Vecchia
items.detail: Gianluca offered a visit. Parked.

stay.name: Orient Express La Minerva
stay.detail: The paid night, 670 euros including VAT and breakfast, as booked. Becomes the comped night if Eden takes the 10th and 11th and Egle agrees to the move.

items.title: Hotel de Russie, site visit proposed
items.detail: Andrea Ercoli (Senior Sales Manager, Rocco Forte) offered a Rome visit. Reply drafted proposing the 12th at 11:00, de Russie first, de la Ville if easier, the 11th at 4:30 as the alternative.

items.title: Six Senses Rome, site visit and spa day
items.detail: Stefano offered a site visit and spa day. On the 22nd he said to let him know at your earliest and they will manage. Touch base around October 5 and set it for the afternoon.

blocks.drive: Banfi to Monteverdi about 1 hour 15. Monteverdi to Porto Ercole about 2 hours. Pellicano to Fiumicino about 1 hour 45.

blocks.name: Amalfi Coast
blocks.summary: Arrive by train and private boat, not the coast road: Rome to Naples by Frecciarossa, Sunrise Sorrento from the port to Le Sirenuse on the 13th. On the 14th a hotel hop by water, San Pietro's dock, Treville, then Santa Caterina for two hosted nights. Depart Naples on the 16th.
blocks.drive: Rome to Positano about 3 hours. No car from October 10, Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for this leg.

days.label: Rome to Positano by train and boat

stay.name: Le Sirenuse, Positano
stay.detail: Confirmed, paid. Lisa Fazzi in Reservations sent the confirmation letter September 22 after the card cleared: October 13 to 14, one night, an industry rate extended personally by Antonio Sersale after Leeann Pisacane's note. Kept over a hosted night at Treville: iconic, and you wanted to sleep there. Sersale family, Franco's Bar, La Sponda. Told them you will most likely arrive by boat.

items.title: Slow morning in Rome, checkout, Termini
Frecciarossa Rome Termini to Napoli Centrale
items.detail: About 1 hour 10. Book a seat.
items.todo: Book the Rome to Naples train for about 12:30 on the 13th.

items.title: Car to the port, private boat to Positano
items.detail: Sent Teresa the full ask September 22: Naples or Sorrento pickup, Le Sirenuse by about 3:30, a swing past Capri, one passenger, two bags, a reduced solo rate. The 14th hotel hop as the second day, the 13th the priority. Waiting on her.

items.title: Arrive Le Sirenuse by sea
items.detail: Porters from the pier. Check in, the terrace, Franco's Bar.

days.label: Hotel hop by boat, then Santa Caterina

stay.name: Hotel Santa Caterina, Amalfi
stay.detail: First of two nights, October 14 to 16, booking #578698902, double room single occupancy, complimentary B&B. Confirmed September 21 by Chiara at the hotel after Valeria D'Amato's offer on behalf of Andrew Camera (Hotel Manager). Nut allergy noted with the kitchen. Site inspection of the hotel and Casa Marchesa during the stay, time to be set on property. You placed the Meckleys and Goffs here.

items.title: Boat from the Positano pier
items.detail: Second Sunrise day asked: Positano, San Pietro's dock, Treville, then Amalfi. Bags by road or on board.

items.title: Il San Pietro di Positano, site visit and tennis
items.detail: Agostino Piccolo, September 16: a pleasure, let him know the date and time. You have not sent the time. Arrive at their dock by boat. You want to play on their court by the sea, so ask Agostino for the court when you confirm 11:00, and allow the late morning for it.
items.todo: Confirm 11:00 AM on the 14th with Agostino, arriving by boat, and ask for the tennis court.

items.title: Villa Treville, site visit
items.detail: Daniela offered to host the 13th, you kept Sirenuse. Reply drafted: thanks, a site visit instead, time to follow within the week. Timing depends on tennis at San Pietro, so Treville is early afternoon on the 14th or drops to next trip. It is next door.

items.title: By boat east to Amalfi, check in at Santa Caterina
items.detail: The hotel has a lift down to its sea platform.

stay.name: Hotel Santa Caterina, Amalfi
stay.detail: Second of two nights, October 14 to 16, booking #578698902, double room single occupancy, complimentary B&B. Confirmed September 21 by Chiara at the hotel after Valeria D'Amato's offer on behalf of Andrew Camera (Hotel Manager). Nut allergy noted with the kitchen. Site inspection of the hotel and Casa Marchesa during the stay, time to be set on property. You placed the Meckleys and Goffs here.

items.title: Santa Caterina and Casa Marchesa, site inspection on the spot
Borgo Santandrea, site visit
items.detail: Antonella Gatto asked September 14 to host, no reply. Now a visit ask, 15 minutes west in Conca dei Marini.

items.detail: Amalfi to Naples airport is about 1 hour 30 without traffic. Timing follows the award flight once the confirmation is in. Arno asked to help.

items.detail: United KYMT99 was cancelled September 19 and refunded in full, $2,260.23, on September 21. The replacement is booked on points. Send the confirmation and the times go here.
